control_failures.control_label: emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: injury during commissioning of replacement equipment on P-4102

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next spot check that the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on P-4102, HX-4120 and PT-4102 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically replacing seals and seal support fluid. P-4102 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was in place but did not perform. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 29 March 2006 an incident occurred on P-4102, HX-4120 and PT-4102 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during commissioning of replacement equipment, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
